note: 本目录为原创整理，仅借鉴「编号+家族+画幅+文字层级」的组织方式，条目名称与指令均为重写，未复制他库文本。

families.use: 小红书封面、朋友圈、公众号次图
公众号题图、知识科普长图、流程图解
角色设定、表情包、周边延展

layouts.name: 大标题压图
layouts.prompt_zh: 标题压在上三分之一，主体落在中下，底部留 8% 安全区
layouts.prompt_en: Big headline across the top third, subject in the lower middle, 8% safe margin at the bottom

layouts.name: 上下分栏
layouts.prompt_zh: 上 45% 主图，下 55% 标题与要点，中间一条细分隔线
layouts.prompt_en: Top 45% image, bottom 55% title and bullets, one thin divider between

layouts.name: 左文右图
layouts.prompt_zh: 左 40% 文字区左对齐，右 60% 画面
layouts.prompt_en: Left 40% left-aligned text block, right 60% imagery

layouts.name: 三宫格
layouts.prompt_zh: 三等分横向排列，每格一个独立小场景
layouts.prompt_en: Three equal columns, one small scene per cell

layouts.name: 九宫格封面
layouts.prompt_zh: 3×3 网格，中心格为主视觉，八格为细节
layouts.prompt_en: 3x3 grid, hero in the center, details around

layouts.name: 杂志封面
layouts.prompt_zh: 顶部刊头横条，中部主视觉，左下角小字栏
layouts.prompt_en: Masthead strip on top, hero image center, small caption column bottom-left

layouts.name: 便签贴纸
layouts.prompt_zh: 主体居中，四周手写便签与箭头标注
layouts.prompt_en: Centered subject, handwritten sticky notes and arrows around

layouts.name: 对比卡
layouts.prompt_zh: 左右各半，中间竖分割线，两侧同构图不同状态
layouts.prompt_en: Split in half with a vertical divider, same framing different states

layouts.name: 清单卡
layouts.prompt_zh: 标题在顶，下面三到五条竖排条目，每条前有编号
layouts.prompt_en: Title on top, three to five numbered rows below

layouts.name: 数据角标
layouts.prompt_zh: 大数字压在角落，主视觉占满，注解小字贴数字下方
layouts.prompt_en: Large number in a corner, full-bleed subject, small caption under it

layouts.name: 相框留白
layouts.prompt_zh: 外围留白 12% 做纸边，中心嵌一张小图
layouts.prompt_en: 12% paper margin, one small image inset in the center

layouts.name: 一句话图
layouts.prompt_zh: 画面九成留白，一句话居中偏上，字号克制
layouts.prompt_en: 90% empty space, one line of text slightly above center

layouts.name: 公众号题图
layouts.prompt_zh: 左侧标题两行，右侧主体，横向宽幅构图
layouts.prompt_en: Two-line title on the left, subject on the right, wide banner framing

layouts.name: 方图题标
layouts.prompt_zh: 主体居中偏右，左上留文字块
layouts.prompt_en: Subject right of center, text block at upper left

layouts.name: 长图头图
layouts.prompt_zh: 顶部大标题，中部主体，底部预告下一节
layouts.prompt_en: Large title on top, subject in the middle, teaser at the bottom

layouts.name: 步骤纵列
layouts.prompt_zh: 四步纵向排列，步骤间箭头连接，每步一行说明
layouts.prompt_en: Four steps stacked vertically, arrows between, one caption per step

layouts.name: 时间轴
layouts.prompt_zh: 中轴竖线，节点左右交替，节点配短标签
layouts.prompt_en: Vertical axis line, alternating nodes with short labels

layouts.name: 对比矩阵
layouts.prompt_zh: 两列多行表格，表头用色块区分
layouts.prompt_en: Multi-row two-column table with colored headers

layouts.name: 金字塔
layouts.prompt_zh: 三层梯形堆叠，底层最宽，逐层文字减少
layouts.prompt_en: Three stacked tiers, widest at the bottom, less text upward

layouts.name: 环形循环
layouts.prompt_zh: 中心图标，外圈四到六段弧，顺时针编号
layouts.prompt_en: Central icon, four to six arcs clockwise around it

layouts.name: 树状分支
layouts.prompt_zh: 左根节点，右侧分三支，连线清晰
layouts.prompt_en: Root node on the left branching into three

layouts.name: 数字阵列
layouts.prompt_zh: 2×3 数据卡，每卡一个大数字与一行注解
layouts.prompt_en: 2x3 data cards, one big number and one caption each

layouts.name: 路径地图
layouts.prompt_zh: 一条路线贯穿画面，节点带图标与地名
layouts.prompt_en: One route across the frame with icon nodes and place names

layouts.name: 长图拼版
layouts.prompt_zh: 多屏连续，每屏一个论点，屏间用色带过渡
layouts.prompt_en: Multiple screens, one argument each, color band transitions

layouts.name: 四格等分
layouts.prompt_zh: 2×2 等分，阅读顺序左上到右下
layouts.prompt_en: 2x2 equal panels, reading order top-left to bottom-right

layouts.name: 六格
layouts.prompt_zh: 两列三行，格间距一致
layouts.prompt_en: Two columns by three rows, even gutters

layouts.name: 主格副格
layouts.prompt_zh: 左侧大格占三分之二，右侧两小格竖排
layouts.prompt_en: Large panel on the left taking two thirds, two small panels stacked right

layouts.name: 条漫
layouts.prompt_zh: 单列纵向长条，每屏一个节拍
layouts.prompt_en: Single vertical column, one beat per screen

layouts.name: 斜切
layouts.prompt_zh: 对角线分割，两格斜向咬合
layouts.prompt_en: Diagonal split, two panels interlocking

layouts.name: 无框融接
layouts.prompt_zh: 取消边框，画面连贯，用明暗区分场景
layouts.prompt_en: No borders, continuous image, scenes separated by light and shadow

layouts.name: 对白位
layouts.prompt_zh: 人物上半身居中，上方与右侧预留气泡空白
layouts.prompt_en: Upper-body figures centered, empty space above and right for balloons

layouts.name: 宽幅三连
layouts.prompt_zh: 三格等高横排，电影比例
layouts.prompt_en: Three equal wide panels in a row, cinematic ratio

layouts.name: 特写插入
layouts.prompt_zh: 主格加一个圆形局部特写插格
layouts.prompt_en: Main panel plus one circular detail inset

layouts.name: 回忆格
layouts.prompt_zh: 整格降饱和加柔边，与现时画面区分
layouts.prompt_en: Desaturated soft-edged panel to separate flashbacks

layouts.name: 三视图
layouts.prompt_zh: 正面侧面背面并列，等高对齐
layouts.prompt_en: Front, side and back views side by side, equal height

layouts.name: 表情九宫格
layouts.prompt_zh: 3×3 同一角色九种表情
layouts.prompt_en: 3x3 grid, nine expressions of one character

layouts.name: 角色卡
layouts.prompt_zh: 上半身立绘占三分之二，下方姓名与三条属性
layouts.prompt_en: Bust portrait taking two thirds, name and three attributes below

layouts.name: 姿态集
layouts.prompt_zh: 四个动作并列，统一光照与比例
layouts.prompt_en: Four poses in a row with consistent lighting and scale

layouts.name: 服饰拆解
layouts.prompt_zh: 角色居中，四周拉出配件小图与引线
layouts.prompt_en: Character centered, accessory callouts with leader lines

layouts.name: 配色板
layouts.prompt_zh: 角色小图在左，右侧五格色卡与比例条
layouts.prompt_en: Small character on the left, five color chips and a ratio bar on the right

layouts.name: 场景应用
layouts.prompt_zh: 角色置于环境中，占画面三分之一
layouts.prompt_en: Character placed in an environment, about one third of the frame

layouts.name: 周边延展
layouts.prompt_zh: 角色居中，四周环绕贴纸徽章玩偶
layouts.prompt_en: Character centered, stickers badges and plush around

layouts.name: 白底主图
layouts.prompt_zh: 纯白背景，产品 45 度悬浮，投影极淡
layouts.prompt_en: Pure white background, product floating at 45 degrees, faint shadow

layouts.name: 场景主图
layouts.prompt_zh: 产品置于使用场景，环境虚化
layouts.prompt_en: Product in a real use scene, blurred environment

layouts.name: 卖点三宫格
layouts.prompt_zh: 上方产品，下方三格卖点图标加短句
layouts.prompt_en: Product on top, three benefit cells with icons below

layouts.name: 参数详情
layouts.prompt_zh: 左图右参数表，行距统一
layouts.prompt_en: Image left, spec table right, even row spacing

layouts.name: 对比图
layouts.prompt_zh: 左右同构图，标前后
layouts.prompt_en: Same framing left and right, labeled before and after

layouts.name: 尺寸标注
layouts.prompt_zh: 产品正视，四周标注线与数字
layouts.prompt_en: Product front view with dimension lines and numbers

layouts.name: 材质特写
layouts.prompt_zh: 微距局部，纹理占满画面
layouts.prompt_en: Macro detail with texture filling the frame

layouts.name: 使用步骤
layouts.prompt_zh: 三步纵向，每步一张小图加一句
layouts.prompt_en: Three vertical steps, one small image and one line each

layouts.name: 套装组合
layouts.prompt_zh: 主件居中，配件环绕排列
layouts.prompt_en: Main item centered with accessories arranged around

layouts.name: 促销角标
layouts.prompt_zh: 主图占满，右上角留价格与折扣位
layouts.prompt_en: Full-bleed product, price and discount slot at upper right

layouts.name: 包装展示
layouts.prompt_zh: 产品与外包装并列，包装略后
layouts.prompt_en: Product beside its packaging, packaging slightly behind

layouts.name: 详情长图
layouts.prompt_zh: 多屏连续，屏间统一页边
layouts.prompt_en: Multiple screens with consistent margins
